column1: # Prefixes of the libc/POSIX docking units. #include is allowed here.
# A .cx file outside these prefixes is a module and must not use #include.
# Each prefix ends with a slash.
# cx/sys/: the L0 sys packages (plans/cx-layers.md). Only time.cx (<time.h>, <poll.h>, <sys/time.h>) and
# net.cx (the three socket headers) include, for headers the prelude lacks; env/fs/proc stay at 0.
